title: Reasoning from stated conditions
bodyMd: An archive permits access to a restricted record only to registered researchers who have written authorization. Registration alone does not guarantee authorization. Mira is registered but has no written authorization. Tomas has both; the passage does not say whether any additional access conditions apply.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.
